_source.spec: CB-315 architect plan #11248 rev 2 §2; Orbweaver-Mobile contracts/frames-v3.json sealed_plaintext
_source.encoding: hex is lowercase; ct is standard base64 with padding of nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16) as in session-vectors.json; screen_hash, nonce, sig and e are base64url without padding

_rules: screen_hash = base64url(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonical_text))). canonical_text: the screen's lines with trailing blank rows dropped, each trimmed, frame edges │┃|║ stripped, trimmed again; from the dialog block's first line up to option 1 — the line after the nearest, walking up from option 1, of a full-width horizontal rule (─━═, 10+ wide), a line outside the ┃│║| frame option 1 sits in (when it sits in one), or a conversation line starting with one of •◦◆◇⏺●✻✶✳✢✽ (blank lines never bound it), never above the bottom 30 drawn lines — keeping only lines holding a letter or digit; then one line per parsed option "{key}. {label}" (wrapped labels joined by the parser, the ❯ cursor not part of it); joined with \n, no trailing \n. The phone never computes this: it echoes the prompt's screen_hash in its answer. The fixtures are here so every screen reader (surface C) and the desktop agree. Fixture cases are regenerated when surface C's wrapped-label join lands; the hash rule does not change. Envelope for the prompt: class action, push amber, id = request_id, e from push-vectors.json. Resolved: push resolve, id = request_id, no e. Refusals: class action, push none.

inputs._note: session_key_epoch0 is session-vectors.json's epoch 0 key (same inputs)
